coverage.reason: The unit test exercises SAVE10, but its truthiness assertion survives a mutation that removes the 10% adjustment.

coverage.obligation: Store credit is subtracted from the total.
coverage.reason: A repository-wide search of JavaScript test files found no assertion that a positive credit reduces the total by the credit amount.

coverage.obligation: The total never falls below zero after store credit is applied.

standards.reason: Assessed the repository-wide instructions that apply to this review; they prescribe review workflow rather than code style for eval-sandbox/r1. The REVIEW.md files in the inventory are scoped to eval/cases/*/pkg and do not apply to these changed files. No changed-line coding-standard violation was found.

layering.reason: Inspected the Node 22 CI configuration and JavaScript test files across src, eval, and eval-sandbox. The changed test uses node:test and node:assert and calls the exported pure function directly without network or a real database, so it is unit-level. No component, integration, or end-to-end assertion covers this function; there is no higher-layer-only logic to push down.
